decisions.reason: Launched only a year ago into a niche the firm knows well, its prospects remain uncertain and keeping a page and a parts base costs little, so the option stays open.
This second two-component injection unit overlaps with A, which raises some risk of consolidation, but one year of results reveals too little to justify abandoning it.
Automatic airless guns are core accessories that share components with the existing range, so holding them is cheap and the option is worth keeping.
A manual airless gun is a staple that complements the pump business at minimal holding cost, so there is no reason to drop it.
The multi-model air-assisted line is still resolving which variants succeed, so the firm should keep the whole line open rather than abandon it early.
The data logger is a digital add-on whose value is still highly uncertain but cheap to maintain, which makes it a classic option worth keeping.
